pricing_note: Secure on-demand Pods only. Prices are the RunPod secure rates observed on 2026-08-31 via /v2/catalog/gpus; the $1.69 figure in older notes was the community rate, and pods here request cloud=SECURE. Serverless for this pool is $3.49/h plus a ~49% platform fee measured on the August 2026 invoice, so it stays blocked by the $3/h cap.
selection_note: Both entries are the same BLACKWELL_96 pool: SM 12.0, 96 GB, one architecture, one image. Listing the Workstation Edition as a sibling widens supply for free -- it is cheaper than the Server Edition and needs no rebuild. Sub-96 GB cards are excluded on capability, not preference: online FP8 and NVFP4 need SM >= 8.9 (so A100/SM80 is out), the SageAttention kernels in this image are compiled for SM 12.0 only (so H100/H200/B200 would need a rebuild), and RunPod secure stock for 32-48 GB cards was zero across all 21 storage-capable North American data centers when this lane was specified.
